N01.hook: CIBIL 780. Phir bhi loan kam kyun mila?
N01.number_card: Income ₹1,00,000 · Existing EMIs ₹35,000 · Limit 50% = ₹50,000 · Room for new EMI ₹15,000 (Example. Not an offer.)
N01.cta: Loan lene wale dost ko bhejo
N01.disclaimer: CredNest is a debt-capital facilitator, not a lender or NBFC. Loan approval and terms are at the lender's sole discretion.

voice_scenes.text: CIBIL 780 hai. Phir bhi loan kam kyun mila?
Kyunki bank score ke baad aapki EMI ka bojh dekhta hai.
Example: kamai ek lakh mahina, purani EMI paintees hazaar.
Agar bank pachaas percent tak EMI maanta hai, to nayi EMI ki jagah sirf pandrah hazaar.
Score achha hai. Jagah kam hai.

N04.hook: ITR ₹12 lakh. Bank statement ₹40 lakh. Bank kis pe bharosa karega?
N04.disclaimer: CredNest is a debt-capital facilitator, not a lender or NBFC. Loan approval and terms are at the lender's sole discretion.

voice_scenes.text: ITR mein baarah lakh. Bank statement mein chaalees lakh.
Bank kis pe bharosa karega?
Zyada lender loan ITR ki kamai pe naapte hain.
Statement sirf yeh dikhata hai ki paisa aaya. Kamai kitni thi, yeh ITR batata hai.
Dono ki kahani ek honi chahiye.

N05.hook: Bank ne CC limit kyun kam ki?
N05.number_card: Stock ₹60L + Debtors ₹40L − Creditors ₹30L = ₹70L · Less 25% margin · Drawing power ₹52.5L (Limit ₹75L) (Example. Not an offer.)
N05.disclaimer: CredNest is a debt-capital facilitator, not a lender or NBFC. Loan approval and terms are at the lender's sole discretion.

voice_scenes.text: Bank ne CC limit kyun kam ki?
Kyunki limit kagaz pe hoti hai. Paisa drawing power se milta hai.
Example: stock saath lakh, debtors chaalees lakh, creditors tees lakh.
Bacha sattar lakh. Pachees percent margin kaato.
Drawing power saadhe baavan lakh. Limit pachhattar lakh hone par bhi.

N08.hook: Bank file reject kyun karta hai? 5 reasons
N08.cta: Save karo. File dene se pehle check karo
N08.disclaimer: CredNest is a debt-capital facilitator, not a lender or NBFC. Loan approval and terms are at the lender's sole discretion.

voice_scenes.text: Bank file reject kyun karta hai? Paanch reason.
Ek: purani EMI zyada.
Do: ITR mein kamai kam.
Teen: cheque ya EMI bounce.
Chaar: property ke kagaz adhure.
Paanch: chhupaya hua loan. Yeh sabse bada.

N11.hook: Profit hai. Phir bhi bank bole capacity kam?
N11.number_card: Cash available ₹30L ÷ Yearly repayment ₹25L = 1.2 (Example. Not an offer.)
N11.disclaimer: CredNest is a debt-capital facilitator, not a lender or NBFC. Loan approval and terms are at the lender's sole discretion.

voice_scenes.text: Profit hai. Phir bhi bank bole capacity kam?
Bank ek simple naap dekhta hai.
Saal mein loan chukane ke liye kitna cash bacha, aur kitna chukana hai.
Example: cash tees lakh, chukana pachees lakh. Naap aaya ek point do.
Kai lender isse zyada cushion maangte hain.

N12.hook: Naya project. CMA ya DPR? Bank pehle kya maangega
N12.cta: Follow karo. Kal ek naya hisaab
N12.disclaimer: CredNest is a debt-capital facilitator, not a lender or NBFC. Loan approval and terms are at the lender's sole discretion.

voice_scenes.text: Naya project. CMA ya DPR?
DPR batata hai project kya hai, kitne ka hai, paisa kaise wapas aayega.
CMA batata hai business ke numbers: pichhle saal aur aane wale saal.
Naye project ke liye zyada lender dono maangte hain.
Pehle DPR, phir uske numbers se CMA.
